concurrency.method: 25 distinct JWT sessions; eight independent loopback PHP HTTP workers share one marked database. Not PHP-FPM or a VPS/SLA test.

integrity.qualification: Exact deltas on fresh authoritative records; bulk performance history is not an accounting certification.

warehouse.qualification: The 72-unit base integrity check runs before these additional count/receipt/transfer/sale races. A stale count must be rejected or post before the concurrent movement.

owned_resources.qualification: CPU is cumulative owned-process time over sampled window; not whole-host CPU utilization. Peaks are per process, not necessarily simultaneous.

queues.method: Two normal database queue workers, one optimizer worker, one simulation worker. Five synthetic 90-day product histories. No operational preparation and no accuracy claim.

python.method: Fresh isolated Python processes, capped BLAS threads, three single-process samples and three pairs. Own-process peak working set and CPU time; no ML accuracy claim.
